alignments.note: Explicit subject pronoun takes only its own *It* (rule 20).
Verbless predicate carrying the construction-supplied copula and the indefinite article; אָשָׁם → *trespass offering*, headed on *trespass* (rules 15, 20, 31).
Cognate infinitive absolute takes the distinct intensifier *certainly* as its own unit (rule 56).
Finite cognate verb keeps its subject pronoun and copula, headed on *guilty*; discontinuous around the intensifier under rule 25.

review_notes: The infinitive absolute takes *certainly* under rule 56, leaving *he is guilty* to the finite verb.
